package.description: A floating desktop widget that shows your AI coding usage limits.

en-US.description: A floating desktop widget that shows your AI coding usage limits.
en-US.longDescription: QuotaBubble is a small, always-on-top desktop bubble that keeps the usage limits for your AI coding tools visible without opening a dashboard, terminal, or browser. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Google Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, DeepSeek, and OpenRouter.
en-US.name: QuotaBubble
